$Comment: Life essence a Disenchanting Table drew out of gear, rung 3 of the disenchanting_essence ladder. An exact item id, so only the plain essence counts; it is the table's ordinary wage, paid for every piece, so this ladder is a measure of pieces unmade weighted by how good they were. STATION_OUTPUT counts a stack the moment it lands in the worker's inventory. One rung of a ladder: Listing.Chains names the ladder and this rung's place in it, and every rung shares ONE FlavorKey whose {0} is filled from TextArgs.Flavor's @amount, so retuning a rung is editing its Amount and nothing in a language file. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts BOTH tables (the greater table's station id starts with the lesser's); a qualifier left out would count the same item at the Sawmill too, so every disenchanting count names it. Announced to the server.
Name: Disenchanting_Essence_T3
